Instead of asking young people "What business would you
like to start?", we ask: "What is one of Africa’s most
pressing problems, and what evidence-based solution can
you design?" Participants work on real policy problems
through Research, Diagnosis, Policy proposal, Prototype,
and Policy pitch, culminating in a Demo Day.
